Advertisement for Dialysis Technician
Saturday, 23 December 2017
5675 Hits
Secretary, Kasturba Health Society invites applications for the post of Haemodialysis Technician/ Dialysis Technician. The application on plain paper enclosing the certified photocopies of the educational qualification and experience must reach to the office of  Medical Superintendent., Kasturba Hospital, Sevagram, Dist Wardha 442102 latest by
15
th
January 2018
.
Qualification & Experience
: Graduate of an Indian University or equivalent with Diploma in Dialysis Technology.  Person having two years experience of working in a reputed haemodialysis center will be preferred.
Job Description
:
Perform haemo-dialysis and peritoneal dialysis as per protocol. Well versed with counseling and managing patients with acute and chronic kidney injuries.  Should be able to clean and disinfect dialysis equipment according to protocol.
Pay Scale: As admissible under the rules of Kasturba Health Society
Age Limit: Between 18 to 35 years
Note:    1. Suitable & experienced candidates can be considered for relaxation in the age limit.
Decision of Selection Committee will be final.
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
